arg.name: launch_audio_capture
arg.description: Launch audio_capture node to publish audio topic from microphone

arg.name: audio_topic
arg.description: Name of audio topic captured from microphone

arg.name: voice_topic
arg.description: Name of text topic of recognized speech

arg.name: n_channel
arg.description: Number of channels of audio topic and microphone. '$ pactl list short sinks' to check your hardware

arg.name: depth
arg.description: Bit depth of audio topic and microphone. '$ pactl list short sinks' to check your hardware

arg.name: sample_rate
arg.description: Frame rate of audio topic and microphone. '$ pactl list short sinks' to check your hardware

arg.name: device
arg.description: Card and device number of microphone (e.g. hw:0,0). you can check card number and device number by '$ arecord -l', then uses hw:[card number],[device number]

arg.name: engine
arg.description: Speech to text engine. TTS engine, Google, GoogleCloud, Sphinx, Wit, Bing Houndify, IBM, Vosk

arg.name: language
arg.description: Speech to text language. For Japanese, set ja-JP.

arg.name: continuous
arg.description: If false, /speech_recognition service is published. If true, /speech_to_text topic is published.

arg.name: auto_start
arg.description: Whether speech_recognition starts automatically or not. This parameter works when continuous is true

arg.name: self_cancellation
arg.description: Do not recognize the audio when robot is speaking or not.

arg.name: tts_tolerance
arg.description: Tolerance second for recognizing whether robot is speaking or not

arg.name: tts_action_names
arg.description: tts action name. these servers outputs are ignored by sound_recognition
